1.w: A song of ascents. When the Lord restored the well-being of Zion, we thought we were dreaming.

2.w: At that time we laughed loudly and shouted for joy. At that time the nations said, “The Lord has accomplished great things for these people.”

3.w: The Lord did indeed accomplish great things for us. We were happy.

4.w: O Lord , restore our well-being, just as the streams in the arid south are replenished.

5.w: Those who shed tears as they plant will shout for joy when they reap the harvest.

6.w: The one who weeps as he walks along, carrying his bag of seed, will certainly come in with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves of grain.
